_comment: LEAGUE POINTS (LP) and League Rank. Every number here is tweakable; nothing in code. Player rank = highest rank whose xp threshold has been reached (xp = lifetime LP earned; SPENDING never lowers it). Opponents have a League Rank 1-8 (stars; 6 Elders, 7 gym leaders, 8 Mewtwo). Base LP is paid on the FIRST win over an opponent only, by that opponent's rank; every bonus pays on every win. Bonuses: groups mean only the highest tier met pays.
_rank_comment: 2026-11-22 (user: a full clear with an average bonus = comfortably rank 5, never rank 6). Sized on the FULL roster: 116 live opponents + the 35 planned new decks still to be added (Incinerator is already Spectator Pete) = 151 opponents beaten ONCE = 6,470 base LP + 154 won games (Elders are Bo3) x ~11 bonus LP = ~8,150 (7,400-9,250 for a 6-18 average). Rank 6 = ~250 rematch wins past a full clear, rank 7 = ~800 more. RE-RUN python Scripts/Utilities/league_rank_check.py after adding opponents or changing LP numbers (it counts the planned decks until they are on opponents). Ranks above visible_ranks are SECRET - the trainer card never shows their LP target until reached.

rank_rewards._comment: rank -> what the Town Hall hands over the first time the player returns at that rank: {"kind": "coin|sleeve|costume", "id": "<asset name>", "label": "text"}. Fill in as you decide them.

_bonus_comment: 2026-11-22 rebalance. NAMES: tier 1 is the plain label, tier 2+ adds tier_prefixes (Healer, Super Healer, Mega Healer, Ultra Healer...). TIERED bonuses (tiers = [[threshold, LP], ...]) pay only the highest tier met. STACKABLE bonuses (lp_each, and each multi_ko kind) pay LP per count and take the prefix from the count (3 Bench KOs = Mega Sniper, +6); a count past the last prefix keeps the last one. Everything is worked out per WON game; a Best-of-3 shows a row earned in both games once as "(x2)". Medals in Medals.json read these bonuses by id + tier number (bonus:healer:4 = Ultra Healer), so adding/removing a tier here can shift which tier a one-off medal means.

comeback.label: Comeback
comeback._comment: threshold = most Prize cards the player was ever BEHIND (opponent's taken minus player's taken)

lucky_heads.label: Lucky Heads
lucky_heads._comment: threshold = share of the player's own flips that were heads; never paid with Unlucky Tails

inflictor._comment: per condition, each its own row and its own cap

multi_ko._comment: opponent's Pokemon Knocked Out in ONE turn (Pokemon, not Prize cards). Each kind stacks: 2 Double Knockouts in a game = Super Double Knockout, +10
